mini_strat.title: Fender: Mini Stratocaster
mini_strat.scope: 22.75-inch scale, lightweight body, C-shaped neck, SSS pickups and hardtail bridge.

mini_strat_beginner.title: Fender: Best Guitar for Beginners — Mini Stratocaster for small hands
mini_strat_beginner.scope: Fender explicitly positions Mini Strat as a good first guitar for younger players or players with small hands.

pgmm31.title: Ibanez: PGMM31 miKro
pgmm31.scope: 22.2-inch scale, 24 frets and twin humbuckers. Compact geometry is factual; beginner suitability is inferred editorially from fit, not claimed as universal standard.

mini_pbass.title: Fender: Mini Precision Bass
mini_pbass.scope: 28.6-inch short scale, lightweight body, C-shaped neck, split single-coil and simple passive controls.

gsrm20.title: Ibanez: GSRM20 miKro
gsrm20.scope: 28.6-inch scale, 38 mm nut width, passive P/J pickups and adjustable bridge.

distinctions: Short scale and lightweight body are separate ergonomic coordinates.
Mini Strat and PGMM31 solve different tone/pickup scenarios at similar compact scale lengths.
Mini Precision and GSRM20 share 28.6-inch scale but differ in pickup/control topology.
Public pages do not claim ONTOS.RENT stock.
